This fails the project's own ML feature-support rule (each RE feature must be nonzero in >=3 training materials). Decision: accept this as a known, documented limitation rather than force in a derived/uncertain data point. Any ML prediction for a Tb-containing composition is EXTRAPOLATION ONLY, never tested by a held-out fold, and must be flagged as such in any resulting analysis or paper -- do not present Tb predictions with the same confidence as elements that have real mixture support.
